description: Output tok/s delta of the tuned config vs. the default config, from a real end-to-end vLLM serving deployment (vllm bench serve, --dataset-name random --random-input-len 256 --random-output-len 128), swept across --max-concurrency. Same two configs as kernel-level-mean-speedup.json, now measured through the full serving stack instead of one isolated GEMM call.
unit: percent, positive = tuned config has higher output tok/s than default
